_comment: Curated theme gallery. Each entry: slug, name, author, description, preview (5 color swatches), css (the full :root { ... } override block), tags, theme_id (16-hex, set by scripts/mint-themes.cjs from sha256('gallery:<slug>')). Submissions arrive via /submit-theme.html and are added here manually after review.
